neabc2bcbaa.headline: Norway Oil and Gas Investment Expected to Drop in 2026
neabc2bcbaa.summary: Norway's oil and gas sector is expected to see investment decline in 2026 as major projects wrap up.
neabc2bcbaa.why: Norway is a major European oil and gas producer, and its investment levels influence supply outlooks and the country's energy revenues.

nccbf04dbc0.headline: AKTOR – SUEZ: Strategic alliance for water management
nccbf04dbc0.summary: AKTOR and SUEZ announced a strategic alliance for water management. All agreements are subject to receipt of necessary regulatory and other approvals.
nccbf04dbc0.why: AKTOR is a Greek construction and infrastructure group, and SUEZ is a French water and waste management company.

n9bc0413456.headline: Organon (OGN) Q4 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
n9bc0413456.summary: Organon, the pharmaceutical company, published the transcript of its fourth-quarter 2025 earnings call.
n9bc0413456.why: Organon is a US pharmaceutical company focused on women's health and biosimilars.

n591dc48255.headline: UK economy barely grew as budget uncertainty weighed
n591dc48255.summary: The UK economy continued its slow pace of growth in the final months of 2025, amid speculation surrounding the budget. Growth was barely positive.
n591dc48255.why: UK GDP growth is a key indicator for the Bank of England's interest rate decisions and for sterling and gilt markets.

n00709a1147.headline: Russia damages over 680 port infrastructure facilities since start of full-scale war – Kuleba
n00709a1147.summary: Russian forces have damaged or destroyed 686 port infrastructure facilities and 150 civilian vessels since the start of the full-scale invasion, Deputy Prime Minister Oleksiy Kuleba said.
n00709a1147.why: Ukraine's ports are key export routes for grain and metals, so damage to port infrastructure affects global commodity supply chains.

n4b8e21c7a2.headline: Shares in wealth manager plunge in earnings bloodbath
n4b8e21c7a2.summary: AMP shares have plummeted amid analyst questions about why shareholders should watch their money being torched. The sell-off followed the wealth manager's earnings.
n4b8e21c7a2.why: AMP is an Australian wealth manager and superannuation provider, so its earnings and capital position matter to investors in Australian financial services.

ncf8ce9e665.headline: Budget 2026: $500 CDC vouchers for all Singaporean households in Jan 2027
ncf8ce9e665.summary: About 1.4 million Singaporean households will each receive $500 in CDC vouchers, disbursed in January 2027 and valid until December 31, 2027.
ncf8ce9e665.why: Budget measures such as household vouchers reflect government fiscal policy, which affects spending, public finances and the outlook for domestic consumption.

n658099d8f9.headline: Aura FAT Projects Acquisition Corp Signs Binding Letter of Intent with Dalmore for Proposed Business Combination
n658099d8f9.summary: Aura FAT Projects Acquisition Corp has signed a binding letter of intent with Dalmore for a proposed business combination, according to a GlobeNewswire release datelined Brisbane.
n658099d8f9.why: A SPAC is a blank-check company that raises capital to acquire a private business, and its deals can change the listing and valuation of the target.

n4c91412446.headline: Kashmir’s Poultry Sector Seeks Policy Shield as Imports Erode Local Market Share
n4c91412446.summary: The Federation of Chambers of Industries Kashmir says the Valley's poultry sector is steadily declining. It is urging the government to protect local producers from rising imports.
n4c91412446.why: Import competition affects domestic producers' margins and market share, which matters for regional food-sector policy.

source.name: Kashmir Life - Latest News & Breaking News from Kashmir

sources.name: Kashmir Life - Latest News & Breaking News from Kashmir

n027fd532ae.headline: East Africa: Ethiopia, France Deepen Strategic Partnership With Landmark Debt Restructuring
n027fd532ae.summary: Ethiopia and France signed historic agreements on debt restructuring and a strategic development partnership. The deals advance Ethiopia's macroeconomic reform and economic recovery efforts.
n027fd532ae.why: Debt restructuring reduces repayment burdens on a sovereign borrower and affects its ability to attract investment and financing. Ethiopia's external debt position is a key factor for international lenders.

n674e035c0f.headline: Energy seller: network costs key factor in power bills
n674e035c0f.summary: Origin Energy's net profit for the half-year ended December 31 fell to $557 million after revenue growth. The company cited network costs as a key factor in power bills.
n674e035c0f.why: Origin Energy is one of Australia's largest electricity and gas retailers and a major energy producer. Its earnings reflect wholesale energy prices and regulated network charges.

n83080a818f.headline: CISAF Support Minimal Cost, EBKEN Slams Delays
n83080a818f.summary: EBKEN criticised government delays on energy cost relief, citing a minimal €50 million CISAF cost and calling for urgent action ahead of EU approval timelines.
n83080a818f.why: CISAF is the EU temporary state-aid framework that lets member states support companies facing high energy costs, so delays affect how quickly relief reaches firms.

n187a45ac3f.headline: E-Invoicing Deadline Ends 12 Feb 2026
n187a45ac3f.summary: From 13 February 2026, non-declared e-invoicing solutions render invoices invalid in Greece, with steep penalties applying to affected businesses.
n187a45ac3f.why: Mandatory e-invoicing rules change how businesses issue and record invoices, and noncompliance can trigger tax penalties.

n4d3052763e.headline: Culture Secretary intervenes in Daily Mail owner’s £500m Telegraph takeover
n4d3052763e.summary: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy has launched an investigation into the £500m takeover of the Telegraph by the Daily Mail owner, citing concerns about competition in the media sector.
n4d3052763e.why: The Daily Mail and General Trust publishes the Daily Mail and is a major UK media group. Government review of media mergers can delay or reshape deals and affects valuations of UK publishers.

n3ab480b831.headline: EU Summit Focuses on Single Market & Competitiveness
n3ab480b831.summary: EU leaders meet informally in Belgium to strengthen the Single Market, cut red tape, boost innovation and explore enhanced cooperation and 'European preference'.
n3ab480b831.why: The EU single market is the bloc's core economic framework, and its rules on trade, regulation and industrial policy shape investment decisions across Europe.

n8182bbc129.headline: Check Point (CHKP) Q4 2025 Earnings Transcript
n8182bbc129.summary: Check Point (CHKP) has published the transcript of its fourth-quarter 2025 earnings call. The source provides no further details on results.
n8182bbc129.why: Check Point is an Israel-based cybersecurity software company that sells network security products to enterprises and governments.

n9c71968334.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Up 0.41%
n9c71968334.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed higher on February 12, 2026, with the General Index up 0.41%. EYDAP and Eurobank led gains amid broad European strength.
n9c71968334.why: The Athens exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its index reflects the performance of the country's largest listed banks and utilities.

impacts.name: Eurobank
impacts.why: Eurobank was named as a leader of the session's gains.

n981c9e1d0f.summary: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy has launched an investigation into the Daily Mail owner's £500m takeover of the Telegraph. Concerns centre on possible effects on competition in the media sector.
n981c9e1d0f.why: Daily Mail and General Trust publishes the Daily Mail, and UK media takeovers are reviewed by government for competition and public-interest concerns.

n2737941372.headline: Budget 2026: $500 Child LifeSG credits for S’porean kids under 12; more to get pre-school subsidies
n2737941372.summary: Families with a Singaporean child aged 12 and below in 2026 will receive S$500 in Child LifeSG Credits per child, usable for groceries and utilities, among other items.
n2737941372.why: Singapore's annual budget sets government spending and household support measures that shape fiscal policy and consumer spending.

n6256f14475.headline: UK Treasury Selects HSBC Blockchain for Digital Gilt Pilot
n6256f14475.summary: The UK Treasury has chosen HSBC's Orion blockchain technology for a trial program of digital gilts. Digital gilts would be UK government bonds issued on a blockchain.
n6256f14475.why: Gilts are UK government bonds, and tokenised issuance could change how sovereign debt is settled and traded.

naaf30b551c.headline: Baseten Raises Funding with Nvidia for AI Chip & Software Innovation
naaf30b551c.summary: Baseten, an AI chip and software startup, has secured funding with support from Nvidia. The company is focused on accelerating AI technology and software solutions.
naaf30b551c.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and its investments in startups shape demand for AI computing infrastructure.

nc522bf7960.headline: Lum Chang Creations H1 net profit more than doubles to S$11 million on strong operational performance
nc522bf7960.summary: Lum Chang Creations' first-half net profit more than doubled to S$11 million on strong operational performance. Revenue rose 31% to S$53.5 million for the period.
nc522bf7960.why: Lum Chang Creations is a Singapore-listed company whose results give investors a read on local construction and engineering activity.

n99326a43ac.headline: Philippines mega sale: 3 massive govt properties up for Manila auction
n99326a43ac.summary: The Philippine government plans to auction three multi-billion-peso prime properties in Taguig and Makati before the end of the year. Proceeds would go to state coffers.
n99326a43ac.why: Asset sales by the state are a way for governments to raise funds and reduce holdings, which can affect the local property market and public finances.

nd73478fb27.headline: BYD launches aggressive 2026 push in Germany, aiming to eclipse SAIC MG and reshape pricing
nd73478fb27.summary: BYD plans to intensify its push into Germany in 2026 by expanding its dealer network and cutting prices steeply. The company targets more than 50,000 annual sales and overtaking SAIC MG as the leading Chinese brand in Europe.
nd73478fb27.why: BYD is a major Chinese electric vehicle maker, and its European expansion pressures incumbent carmakers' pricing and market share.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: Expansion and price cuts in Germany define BYD's European growth strategy.

nab8632803b.headline: VNPAY and Napas deepen cooperation on digital payments - VnExpress International
nab8632803b.summary: VNPAY and Napas agreed to expand cooperation on next-generation payment technologies. The aim is to speed digital payment adoption and strengthen financial connectivity in Vietnam.
nab8632803b.why: VNPAY is a Vietnamese payments company and Napas is the national interbank switch, so their cooperation affects how electronic payments flow in Vietnam.

n2dc439efd1.headline: Gogoro Releases Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
n2dc439efd1.summary: Gogoro, the Nasdaq-listed battery-swapping technology company, released its fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 financial results. The release covers its sustainable mobility ecosystem business.
n2dc439efd1.why: Gogoro makes electric scooters and a battery-swapping network used in Taiwan and other Asian markets. Its results indicate the commercial progress of swapping-based electric mobility.

ndc7ac866b1.headline: Indonesian retail sales post strong annual gain
ndc7ac866b1.summary: Preliminary data show Indonesian retail sales far stronger than a year earlier. Consumers are upbeat about the near-term outlook heading into the new year.
ndc7ac866b1.why: Household consumption is a major driver of Indonesia's GDP, so retail trends feed into growth and consumer-company earnings.

nf0442910e5.headline: Economic slowdown highlights need to strengthen Philippine manufacturing — Metro-Manila
nf0442910e5.summary: The Philippine economy has slowed, prompting calls to strengthen domestic manufacturing. The report cites workers at an apparel plant in Cebu's export processing zone.
nf0442910e5.why: Manufacturing and export processing are major drivers of growth and employment in the Philippines. A slowdown in the sector affects the country's trade balance and overall economic growth.

n6e4525523a.headline: Cognex (CGNX) Q4 2025 Earnings Transcript
n6e4525523a.summary: A transcript of Cognex's fourth-quarter 2025 earnings call has been published. The document covers the company's results for that quarter.
n6e4525523a.why: Cognex is a machine vision company whose industrial imaging and barcode systems are used in factory automation. Its quarterly results give investors insight into demand for automation equipment.
